content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: CSIR-CFTRI has announced 28 Technician (1) vacancies in 13 technical trades, including Fitter, Electronics Mechanic, Instrument Mechanic, Laboratory Assistant, COPA, Electrician, Carpenter and Welder. The trade-wise vacancies are given below. content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the prescribed educational and trade requirements as on 18 November 2026. The minimum qualification is Class 10 or equivalent with Science subjects and at least 55% marks, along with one of the accepted trade qualifications or experience routes. Applicants must meet the Class 10 Science and 55% marks requirement and satisfy any one of the following conditions in the relevant trade: ITI certificate or National/State Trade Certificate in the concerned trade. Two years of full-time apprenticeship training in the concerned trade from a recognized institution. Three years of work experience in the concerned trade in an eligible Central or State Government department, public sector undertaking or autonomous organization, as specified in the notification. The required ITI certificate or experience must correspond to the trade selected in the application. Candidates should check the exact trade name and supporting-document conditions in the official notification. The minimum age for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026 is 18 years and the maximum age is 28 years as on 18 November 2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to eligible candidates under Government of India rules. Additional relaxation provisions apply to eligible widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husbands who have not remarried. Candidates seeking relaxation must provide the prescribed supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Technician (1) post carries Pay Level 2 under the 7th Central Pay Commission, with a pay scale of Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200. The notification mentions approximate monthly emoluments of Rs. 37,260 at the minimum of the pay scale, including admissible House Rent Allowance at Mysuru headquarters. Selected employees may also receive applicable Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, medical benefits, Leave Travel Concession and other benefits under CSIR rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 500 for candidates who are not eligible for exemption. SC, ST, PwBD, women and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the fee, subject to the required documentary proof. The fee must be paid through SBI Collect and the payment receipt uploaded to the application portal. The application fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one post code must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee for each application.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for Technician (1) posts consists of application screening, a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive written examination. Candidates shortlisted after screening will be invited for the relevant Trade Test. Only those who qualify in the Trade Test will proceed to the written examination. The written examination consists of three papers. Paper I is qualifying in nature, while marks obtained in Papers II and III determine the final merit list, subject to the prescribed conditions. The total examination duration is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Paper I has no negative marking, while Papers II and III carry a penalty of one mark for each incorrect answer. The question paper will be in English and Hindi, except for the English Language section. The minimum qualifying marks for the Trade Test and Paper I will be determined and notified by the institute. Papers II and III will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify in Paper I.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply through the official CSIR-CFTRI recruitment portal until 18 November 2026. Submission of the online form alone is not sufficient. Candidates must also send the signed hard copy with the prescribed documents so that it reaches the institute by 26 November 2026. Recruitment Section (E-I Section), CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute, Cheluvamba Mansion (Opposite to Rail Museum), Mysuru - 570020, Karnataka. Applications that do not meet the online submission and hard copy requirements within the prescribed deadlines will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The CSIR CFTRI Technician online application link is available on the institute's recruitment portal. Candidates can submit their applications until 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The physical application with supporting documents must reach the institute by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSIR-CFTRI has announced 28 Technician (1) vacancies across 13 trades.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application, complete applicable fee payment and download the form is 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Is sending the hard copy mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes. The signed application and required supporting documents must reach CSIR-CFTRI by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Can 10th Pass candidates apply without ITI?
faq.answer: Yes, provided they have passed 10th with Science subjects and at least 55% marks and meet the alternative qualification route of two years of prescribed apprenticeship training or three years of relevant qualifying work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR CFTRI Technician?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 28 years as of 18 November 2026, with applicable category-based relaxations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for CSIR CFTRI Technician?
faq.answer: The posts carry Pay Level 2 (Rs. 19,900–63,200), with approximate monthly emoluments of Rs. 37,260 at Mysuru headquarters.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for applicable categories. SC, ST, PwBD, women and Ex-servicemen candidates are exempt, subject to the prescribed conditions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes application screening, a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive Written Examination. Final merit is based on Paper II and Paper III marks.

faq.question: Q9. How many questions are in the Technician written examination?
faq.answer: The examination has 150 objective questions carrying a maximum of 400 marks over 150 minutes.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply for more than one trade?
faq.answer: Yes, if eligible. Candidates must submit separate complete applications and applicable fees for each post code.
